paragraphs: Yitzḥak Resh Galuta (Rav Bivi’s sister’s son, Yevamot 115b [Heilprin reads רב where the Bavli has בר]). This was his name; he was not an Exilarch, as recorded in the responsa of the Rosh (collection 50 as cited; compare 51:2, in the reply addressed to the Rosh). For how could he have walked alone, and how could it say, 'We are concerned that there might be two Exilarchs'?
